chapter: The Jelly Roll Morton records and Minton's Playhouse
title: Caldwell leaves Minton's after six months; Henry Minton's death
summary: He left to go on the road, remembers banking for Minton, and says Minton died in 1969 and was buried by his lodge.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Remembering Jelly Roll Morton: the man, the band

blocks.x: Well, how long did you stay there?
Oh, I stayed there about six months.

Yeah, because I had a job to go on the road with this man. The old money was bigger. Bill Mann, he and I was very close. He wanted me to leave because lot of times in the morning I'd go down there, take his bank book to the bank and deposit it in his, you know, bank, and then the checking account, we'd pick up the money and then come back for the bartenders and wages they had for the night. So we were very good buddies, very good friends and all that.
Well, how -- when did Minton die?
The old man died, let's see. This is '76. He died in -- I think it was '69 because we funeralized him at the temple. He was one of the old members of that lodge.
Well, I mean, now who took the place over when he died?
